body:
15 looks. all 12 eras. 39 real red-carpet and tour photographs, every single one credited to the photographer who shot it. that's The Runway, and building it made me fall for her style evolution all over again 🤍

why: The Runway's only September slot (behind-the-data), window-bound to 09-16. The number hook. Counts verified from supabase/seed/lenses/runway-looks.mjs: 15 looks, 12 distinct eras, 39 total images, all credited (Getty/Kevin Mazur/press). DROPPED the calendar's 'how many looks are tappable now' angle: it does not hold — RUNWAY_LOOKS.shopTags render as static descriptor chips, not tap-to-shop links (verified RunwayThread.tsx:129-136). Flagged for Tree in the PR body. Thread post = share-hook exempt. Selector-chosen credited evermore photo (X site-screen prohibited).

critique.rationale: Runway behind-the-data: 15 looks across all 12 eras, 39 credited real photographs, no mockups — counted from RUNWAY_LOOKS, not estimated. Dropped the calendar's 'tappable looks' angle: Runway shopTags are static chips, not shop links (RunwayThread.tsx).
